name: 优质模板库 - 筛选专项(4筛选+洗图状态+应用场景+标签+重置)
description: 覆盖优质模板库全部筛选功能：4个基础筛选(模板来源Select/Seller ID/店铺名称/模板组ID)+洗图状态筛选+应用场景筛选+7维度标签+重置按钮+筛选结果验证。

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder], input.ant-input'); const selects = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select'); const labels = document.querySelectorAll('label, .ant-form-item-label, [class*=label], [class*=filter-title]'); const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button, .ant-btn'); return { inputCount: inputs.length, inputs: Array.from(inputs).map(i=>({placeholder:i.placeholder,type:i.type})), selectCount: selects.length, selectTexts: Array.from(selects).map(s=>s.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item,.ant-select-selection-placeholder')?.textContent?.trim()||''), labels: Array.from(labels).map(l=>l.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,15), hasReset: Array.from(btns).some(b=>/重置/.test(b.textContent)), buttonLabels: Array.from(btns).map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,10) }; })()
steps.description: 探查全部筛选组件: Input/Select/Label/重置按钮
开始网络抓包-监控筛选API

steps.expression: (() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=card],[class*=template],[class*=thumb],[class*=item]'); const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]'); return { initialCardCount: cards.length, initialCheckboxCount: checkboxes.length }; })()
steps.description: 记录初始卡片/checkbox数量(筛选前基准)
获取模板来源选项列表
选择第一个模板来源选项
统计模板来源筛选后卡片数量

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder]'); const hasValue = Array.from(inputs).some(i => i.value && i.value.trim()); return { allCleared: !hasValue, inputValues: Array.from(inputs).map(i=>({placeholder:i.placeholder,value:i.value})) }; })()
steps.description: 验证重置后所有筛选条件已清空

steps.expression: (() => { const radios = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-button-wrapper, .ant-radio-wrapper, [class*=radio]'); const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab'); const hasWashStatus = Array.from(document.body.querySelectorAll('*')).some(el => /洗图状态/.test(el.textContent)); return { hasWashStatus, radioCount: radios.length, radioTexts: Array.from(radios).map(r=>r.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,10), tabCount: tabs.length }; })()
steps.description: 探查洗图状态筛选形式(Radio/Tab/Select)

steps.expression: (() => { const radio = document.querySelector('.ant-radio-button-wrapper, .ant-radio-wrapper'); if(radio) { radio.click(); return { clicked: true, text: radio.textContent.trim() }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击洗图状态筛选选项

steps.expression: (() => { const hasAppScene = Array.from(document.body.querySelectorAll('*')).some(el => /应用场景/.test(el.textContent)); return { hasAppSceneFilter: hasAppScene }; })()
steps.description: 探查应用场景筛选是否存在

steps.expression: (() => { const selects = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select'); const appSel = Array.from(selects).find(s => { const prev = s.previousElementSibling; const label = prev?.textContent || s.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-placeholder')?.textContent || ''; return /应用场景|场景/.test(label); }); if(appSel) { appSel.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const dims = ['设计','搭配','拍摄','场景','光影','构图','视觉']; const tags = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=tag], .ant-tag, [class*=dimension]'); return { tagCount: tags.length, tagTexts: Array.from(tags).map(t=>t.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,15), dimFound: dims.map(d => ({dim:d, found: Array.from(tags).some(t=>t.textContent.includes(d))})) }; })()

(() => { const tag = document.querySelector('[class*=tag], .ant-tag, [class*=dimension]'); if(tag) { tag.click(); return { clicked: true, text: tag.textContent.trim() }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
(() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder]'); const hasValue = Array.from(inputs).some(i => i.value && i.value.trim()); return { finalCleared: !hasValue }; })()

realDomNotes: 优质模板库筛选专项: ①模板来源(Select, AntD mouse.click) ②Seller ID(fill react:true) ③店铺名称(fill react:true) ④模板组ID(fill react:true) ⑤洗图状态(Radio/Tab/Select) ⑥应用场景(Select) ⑦7维度标签 ⑧重置按钮。
preconditions: F88预发环境可访问，测试账号已登录，当前身份为F88，优质模板库存在数据
